remarks:
Welcome to Hawthorn Lane, one of Allegany's most prestigious streets, and to a home that delivers space, comfort, and quality at every turn.

The covered front porch sets the tone. It's a great place for morning coffee or unwinding at the end of the day. Inside, about 2,700 square feet gives you plenty of room. The main floor has a formal living room and a separate family room, so you can entertain guests and still have a spot to relax with the family. First-floor laundry adds everyday convenience.

Upstairs, four bedrooms offer plenty of space, and four full bathrooms throughout the home (2 upstairs, 1 on the main level, 1 in the basement) mean no more bathroom lines. The finished basement adds even more living space, with a rec room or second living area and a bonus room that could serve as a fifth bedroom.

The big updates are already done. The roof is brand new as of October 2026, and central air keeps the home cool and comfortable all summer long.

Out back, the outdoor living continues. The back deck is getting new composite decking in the coming weeks, so it will be low-maintenance and ready for summer gatherings. A gazebo adds another versatile space for dining, relaxing, or entertaining under cover.

The attached two-car garage keeps you out of the weather. An additional parking area handles guests and extra vehicles. To the left of the garage, an exterior 220 line once powered a hot tub. It's ready for a new one or could easily be converted into an electric car charger.

Homes on Hawthorn Lane don't come up often. We derived the square footage from the floor plans. Schedule your private showing today.
